message: test(onboarding): verify XP and objectives do not overlap in either responsive column layout
purpose: All 14 new layout profiles and 258 native experience checks passed. The retained ChallengeHudChecks assumed the quest card was always below vitals in one column. Preserve actual non-overlap, viewport containment and expanded-status checks while respecting the now-supported separate-column layout; retain the original vertical-gap requirement whenever the panels share a column.

replacements.old: check(Find<Control>("Vitals").GetGlobalRect().End.Y<=quest.GetGlobalRect().Position.Y+1,"XP feedback does not overlap the objective tracker");
check(Find<Control>("Vitals").GetGlobalRect().End.Y+5<=quest.GetGlobalRect().Position.Y,"Wrapped status information moves the objective panel rather than covering it");
